ac_sparql.figure.construction_resident.alt: Construction phases and current and peak whole-process resident memory plotted against Pod count and realized content triples for both lanes and domains.
ac_sparql.figure.construction_resident.note: RSS is a conservative whole-process indicator, not isolated server heap.

ac_sparql.figure.factor_sensitivities.alt: Twenty panels show descriptive timing medians and instrumentation counts for every documents, triples, ACL placement/depth, and visibility sensitivity level.
ac_sparql.figure.factor_sensitivities.note: Complete q1/q8 sensitivity matrix; panel-local log scales and no fitted trends.

ac_sparql.figure.guarded_stack_content_r.alt: Sixteen panels show wall and CPU guarded-stack/content-reference paired ratios and differences for every primary query, domain, lane, and Pod count with block-bootstrap intervals.
ac_sparql.figure.guarded_stack_content_r.note: Complete guarded-stack/content-reference contrast against a query-answer-equivalent content-only physical reference; not pure authorization overhead or an otherwise-identical same-data counterfactual. All cells are shown without pooling or favourable selection.

ac_sparql.figure.http_backend_operations.alt: Native HTTP backend operations per q1 request versus resident Pod count, separated by domain.
ac_sparql.figure.http_backend_operations.note: Instrumentation count figure; instrumentation timings are not latency evidence.

ac_sparql.figure.pod_scaling_latency.alt: Median warm guarded-query latency versus resident Pod count for q1 and q8, separated by lane and domain.
ac_sparql.figure.pod_scaling_latency.note: Analyzer-generated primary scaling figure; descriptive medians are bound by its SHA-256.

comparison_boundary.limitation: The guarded datasets and request paths may include structural/control graphs, authentication, assembly, and API work; this is neither pure access-control overhead nor an otherwise-identical same-data counterfactual.

workload.dataset: Deterministic count-calibrated social and compact-health corpora; not a sample of deployed Pods

h2_decision_rule.joint: A cell meets H2 only when both wall and process-CPU upper bounds satisfy both margins.

workload.query_scope: All eight predeclared query families in the primary intervention and q1/q8 in every sensitivity cell
